content.text: All preferred elements are present in § 18. No redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets the preferred position in full: § 18.1 requires Vendor-maintained CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional E&O of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (given unconditionally, so broader than the preferred "if Vendor processes Customer Data" trigger), and § 18.2 requires certificates of insurance on request. Additional employer's liability, primary-coverage, cancellation-notice and non-limitation terms are extras that favour us. No deviation; no redline proposed.
